# FTI Capital Advisors Advises Ooredoo Group on AI Compute Expansion Through Investment in Zankore Alongside Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison, NVIDIA and Nokia


Doha, 6 August 2026 — FTI Capital Advisors DIFC Limited (“FTICA”), a wholly owned subsidiary of FTI Consulting, Inc. (NYSE: FCN), advised Ooredoo Group (“Ooredoo”) on its expansion into AI compute through an investment in Zankore alongside Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison, NVIDIA and Nokia. The Indonesian company provides a dedicated AI compute and neocloud platform with full-stack AI capabilities.


As the founding shareholder and lead investor with a 49% stake, Ooredoo Group will commit approximately US$800 million to support the platform’s launch and initial development.


The investment expands Ooredoo’s existing digital infrastructure portfolio, adding AI compute capabilities to strengthen its presence in Southeast Asia’s AI infrastructure market.


Fede Membrillera, Global Co-Leader of FTICA and Global Leader of FTICA’s Telecom, Media & Technology practice, said, “We are proud to have supported Ooredoo in this landmark transaction. AI is expected to drive economic growth in emerging markets, and Zankore is uniquely positioned to lead that journey, combining the complementary strengths of Ooredoo, Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison, NVIDIA and Nokia under one single platform to build next-generation AI infrastructure for Southeast Asia.”


**About FTI Capital Advisors, LLC**
[FTI Capital Advisors](https://capitaladvisors.fticonsulting.com/) (“FTICA”) is a global M&A advisory firm with offices in 13 countries, focused on M&A, equity and debt raising and independent financial advisory, across targeted industry sectors – including telecom, media and technology, as well as in the energy, financial services, healthcare, aviation & aerospace, industrials and insurance. Backed by the power of FTI Consulting’s worldwide network of professionals, FTICA combines deep industry expertise with investment banking and transaction execution experience to deliver value-enhancing outcomes for our clients. FTI Capital Advisors globally is the wholly owned investment banking subsidiary of FTI Consulting, Inc.


The transaction was supported by FTI Capital Advisors (DIFC) Limited (“FTICA Dubai”), an affiliate of FTICA. FTICA Dubai is regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (“DFSA”), the financial regulatory agency of the special economic zone, the Dubai International Financial Centre (“DIFC”), in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. FTICA Dubai is authorized to provide services to Professional Clients only; accordingly, this press release is intended for Professional Clients only, and no other person should act upon it.
